visualCharacteristics.purpose: side-by-side columns, by default two alternatives separated by an "or" divider

contentPattern.structure: one row with one cell per column (usually two). An optional short middle cell such as "or" sets the divider text. Columns can hold heading, text, links, an image, or a table

usage: Offer comparisons on mortgage and home-equity pages; image + text promos on home and banking pages.
reuseGuidance: media-promo: image column + text column; promo-banner: text with image to the right; with-tables: columns hold tables; with-icons: centred icon cards. Promo options have no divider.
